decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used for aromatheraphy massage and hydrotheraphy spa-bath treatment centre and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for an aromatheraphy massage and hydrotheraphy spa-bath treatment centre purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 10h00 to 20h00 (Mon - Fri), 09h30 to 18h00 (Sat), 11h00 to 17h00 (Sun).
Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the various treatment rooms shall have a minimum clear width of 750mm.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the 1st and 2nd floors shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 6 - There shall be no more than 2  car parking spaces on the site.
description: Change of use of 1st & 2nd floors from pharmacy & offices into aromatherapy massage & hydrotherapy spa-bath treatment centre
